post_topic: Showing Signal product launch — inbox-native real estate automation
image_description:
Single standalone diagram. One concept only. No panels, no grids, no collages. Full bleed 1080x1080px white background.

A left-to-right horizontal flow diagram titled 'Showing Signal — How It Works' in large bold text at the top center.

Far left: a box labeled 'ShowingTime Confirmation Email' with a small email envelope icon inside. Below the box, a small label reads 'Arrives in agent inbox'.

A bold rightward arrow from that box leads to a central processing box labeled 'Showing Signal' in large text, with a subtitle 'Inbox-native parser' below it. This box is highlighted with a blue #5a96ff border and is the visual focal point of the diagram.

From the 'Showing Signal' box, two arrows branch rightward: one arrow pointing up-right to a box labeled 'CRM' with a small database icon, and one arrow pointing down-right to a box labeled 'Email Sequences' with a small email sequence icon.

Above the central arrow path, a horizontal callout label in amber #F5A623 reads 'No API key. No Zapier. No manual entry.'

Below the entire flow, a small annotation row shows three crossed-out items in light gray text: '✕ ShowingTime API' and '✕ Zapier middleware' and '✕ Manual data entry' — each struck through.

Navy #0A0F1E primary elements, blue #5a96ff highlights, amber #F5A623 callouts and important labels. Clean sans-serif font. Real cloud provider logos where relevant. Small text 'Kelvin Davis' bottom right corner. Professional LinkedIn infographic style similar to ByteByteGo. White background. No dark backgrounds.
